### Finalized TSVs
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
source("../R/nature_biotech_ggplot.R")

filter_status_colours <- c(
  "kept" = "#4C72B0",
  "removed_unrelated_pon" = "#009E73",
  "unrelated_pon_removed" = "#D62728",
  "removed_germline" = "#D62728"
)

raw <- read_tsv("../raw_data/raw_duplex_pileup_newPTA_altge1.tsv")
nogerm <- read_tsv("../raw_data/no_germline.no_blacklist.duplex_pileup_newPTA_altge1.tsv")
filt <- read_tsv("../raw_data/no_unrelated.no_germline.no_blacklist.duplex_pileup_newPTA_altge1_unrel_lowci.tsv")
```

### Fig 3b
```{r fig3b, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=4.5, dpi=450}
library(grid)


call_cols_full_depth <- c(
  "call_Illumina",
  "call_ppmSeq_multiread",
  "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC",
  "call_UDSeq_multiread",
  "call_UDSeq_singleton",
  "call_NanoSeq_multiread",
  "call_NanoSeq_singleton",
  "call_HiDEFseq_double_stranded",
  "call_HiDEFseq_single_stranded",
  "call_PTA_singleton"
)

no_black <- raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    blacklist_any==0,
    gnomad_common==0,
    in_hmer7==0,
    in_simple_repeats_ucsc==0
  )

count_calls <- function(df, call_cols){
  df %>%
    summarise(
      dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(call_cols), ~ sum(.x==1, na.rm=TRUE))
    )
}

# ---- Step0: before filtering ----
cnt0 <- count_calls(no_black, call_cols_full_depth)

# ---- Germline filter (is_germline + any germline_like) ----
gll_cols <- colnames(no_black)[stringr::str_detect(
  colnames(no_black),
  "^is_germline_like_upper_ci_052_"
)]

after_germline <- no_black %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !(is_germline==1 |
      rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(gll_cols), ~ as.integer(.x==1)), na.rm=TRUE) > 0)
  )

cnt1 <- count_calls(after_germline, call_cols_full_depth)

# ---- Unrelated filter ----
after_unrelated_pon <- after_germline %>%
  dplyr::filter(existing_in_unrelated==0)
  #dplyr::filter(altge1_in_unrelated==0)

cnt2 <- count_calls(after_unrelated_pon, call_cols_full_depth)

# ---- Final table (rows = callset) ----
out2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  cnt0 %>% mutate(stage="before_filter"),
  cnt1 %>% mutate(stage="after_germline"),
  cnt2 %>% mutate(stage="after_unrelated_pon")
) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-stage, names_to="callset", values_to="n") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=stage, values_from=n) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    callset,
    before_filter,
    after_germline,
    after_unrelated_pon
  )

out2


viz_rel_stacked <- out2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(callset = factor(callset, levels = rev(out2$callset))) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    before = before_filter,
    after_germline = after_germline,
    after_pon = after_unrelated_pon
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    removed_germline = (before - after_germline) / before,
    removed_unrelated_pon      = (after_germline - after_pon) / before,
    kept             = after_pon / before
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(callset, removed_germline, removed_unrelated_pon, kept) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    -callset,
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "prop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    component = factor(
      component,
      levels = c("removed_germline", "removed_unrelated_pon", "kept")
    )
  )

new_lev <- viz_rel_stacked$callset %>% levels(.) %>% str_replace_all(., "^call_", "")
viz_rel_stacked$callset <- viz_rel_stacked$callset %>% str_replace_all(., "^call_", "")
viz_rel_stacked$callset <- factor(viz_rel_stacked$callset, levels = new_lev)


lab_df <- viz_rel_stacked %>%
  dplyr::mutate(component = as.character(component)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(callset) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(component, c("kept", "removed_unrelated_pon", "removed_germline")), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_center = cumsum(prop) - prop / 2,
    y_edge   = cumsum(prop),
    y_line   = y_edge + 0.010,
    y_label  = y_edge + 0.028,
    label = ifelse(
      prop >= 0.03,
      scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1),
      scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.01)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

ggplot(viz_rel_stacked, aes(x = callset, y = prop, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +

  # inside
  geom_text(
    data = lab_df %>% dplyr::filter(prop >= 0.03),
    aes(x = callset, y = y_center, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.5,
    family = "Arial"
  ) +

  # thin connector line
  geom_segment(
    data = lab_df %>% dplyr::filter(prop < 0.03, prop > 0),
    aes(x = callset, xend = callset, y = y_edge, yend = y_line),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  # label
  geom_text(
    data = lab_df %>% dplyr::filter(prop < 0.03, prop > 0),
    aes(x = callset, y = y_label, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 2.4,
    family = "Arial"
  ) +

  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = normalize_seq_method) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = filter_status_colours,
    breaks = c("kept", "removed_unrelated_pon", "removed_germline"),
    labels = c("Kept", "Unrelated PoN removed", "Germline removed"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion (%)") +
  theme_nbt(base_size = 7)

```
### Fig 3c
```{r fig3c, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.7, dpi=450}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

call_cols_full_depth <- c(
  "call_Illumina",
  "call_ppmSeq_multiread",
  "call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC",
  "call_UDSeq_multiread",
  "call_UDSeq_singleton",
  "call_NanoSeq_multiread",
  "call_NanoSeq_singleton",
  "call_HiDEFseq_double_stranded",
  "call_HiDEFseq_single_stranded",
  "call_PTA_singleton"
)


maf_map <- list(
  call_Illumina = "ILLUMINA_MAF",
  call_ppmSeq_multiread = "DUPLEX_PPMSEQ_MAF",
  call_ppmSeq_singleton_HC = "DUPLEX_PPMSEQ_MAF",
  call_UDSeq_multiread = "DUPLEX_UDSEQ_MAF",
  call_UDSeq_singleton = "DUPLEX_UDSEQ_MAF",
  call_NanoSeq_multiread = "DUPLEX_NANOSEQ_MAF",
  call_NanoSeq_singleton = "DUPLEX_NANOSEQ_MAF",
  call_HiDEFseq_double_stranded = "DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ_MAF",
  call_HiDEFseq_single_stranded = "DUPLEX_HIDEFSEQ_MAF"
)

maf_plot_df <- lapply(names(maf_map), function(cc){

  maf_col <- maf_map[[cc]]

  nogerm %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[cc]] == 1) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      callset = stringr::str_replace(cc, "^call_", ""),
      group = ifelse(existing_in_unrelated == 1,
                     "unrelated_pon_removed",
                     "kept"),
      MAF = .data[[maf_col]]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(callset, group, MAF)

}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(MAF), MAF > 0, MAF <= 0.3)

maf_plot_df$callset <- maf_plot_df$callset %>% factor(., levels=unique(maf_plot_df$callset))

ggplot(maf_plot_df, aes(x = MAF, fill = group)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 120,
    alpha = 0.45,
    position = "identity",
    color = NA
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~callset,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 1,
    labeller = ggplot2::labeller(callset = normalize_seq_method)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = filter_status_colours,
    breaks = c("kept", "unrelated_pon_removed"),
    labels = c("Kept", "Unrelated PoN removed"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Platform-specific BAM MAF (0-0.3)",
    y = "Number of variants"
  ) +
  theme_nbt(base_size = 7)
```

### Fig 3d
```{r fig3d, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.2, dpi=450}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(UpSetR)



# ---- Build matrix for UpSetR (missing cols -> 0) ----
make_mat_strata <- function(df, cols) {
  out <- lapply(cols, function(x) {
    if (x %in% colnames(df)) as.integer(df[[x]] %in% 1) else rep(0L, nrow(df))
  })
  mat <- as.data.frame(out, check.names = FALSE)
  colnames(mat) <- cols
  rownames(mat) <- NULL
  mat
}

mat_calls <- make_mat_strata(filt, call_cols_full_depth)

colnames(mat_calls) <- normalize_seq_method(
  str_replace(colnames(mat_calls), "^call_", "")
)

# ---- Plot ----
old_theme <- ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_get() + theme_nbt(base_size = 7))

fig3d <- upset(
  mat_calls,
  nsets = ncol(mat_calls),
  nintersects = 200,
  keep.order = TRUE,
  order.by = "freq",
  mainbar.y.label = "Intersection size",
  sets.x.label = "Set size",
  matrix.color = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]],
  main.bar.color = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]],
  sets.bar.color = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]],
  text.scale = c(7/8.3, 1, 7/8.3, 1, 0.8, 1)
)

break_lower <- 16000
break_upper <- 58000
break_spacer <- 500

map_broken_axis <- function(value) {
  ifelse(
    value >= break_upper,
    break_lower + break_spacer + value - break_upper,
    value
  )
}

break_tick_raw <- c(0, 5000, 10000, 15000, 60000)
break_tick_display <- map_broken_axis(break_tick_raw)
size_break_tick_raw <- c(0, 10000, 60000)
size_break_tick_display <- map_broken_axis(size_break_tick_raw)

main_bar_data <- UpSetR:::Counter(
  fig3d$New_data,
  length(fig3d$Set_names),
  fig3d$first.col,
  fig3d$Set_names,
  200,
  NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]],
  "freq",
  "degree",
  NULL,
  NULL,
  TRUE
)

if (any(main_bar_data$freq > break_lower & main_bar_data$freq < break_upper)) {
  stop("Compressed Fig. 3d axis is invalid: an intersection lies inside the omitted range.")
}

main_bar_data <- main_bar_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    display_freq = map_broken_axis(freq)
  )

bar_break_marks <- main_bar_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(freq >= break_upper) %>%
  dplyr::select(x) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(mark = c(1, 2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x_start = x - 0.28,
    x_end = x + 0.28,
    y_start = ifelse(
      mark == 1,
      break_lower - 100,
      break_lower + break_spacer - 100
    ),
    y_end = y_start + 200
  )

main_axis_break_marks <- data.frame(
  x_start = c(0, 0.10),
  x_end = c(0.16, 0.26),
  y_start = c(
    break_lower - 100,
    break_lower + break_spacer - 100
  )
)
main_axis_break_marks$y_end <- main_axis_break_marks$y_start + 200

main_y_max <- max(main_bar_data$display_freq) * 1.1

main_bar_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  main_bar_data,
  ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = display_freq)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.6,
    fill = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]]
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black") +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black") +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = break_lower,
    ymax = break_lower + break_spacer,
    fill = "white",
    colour = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = main_axis_break_marks,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_end,
      y = y_start,
      yend = y_end
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = bar_break_marks,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = x_start,
      xend = x_end,
      y = y_start,
      yend = y_end
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = freq),
    family = "Arial",
    size = 2.2,
    vjust = -1,
    angle = 0,
    colour = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]]
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, nrow(main_bar_data) + 1),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, main_y_max),
    breaks = break_tick_display,
    labels = scales::comma(break_tick_raw, accuracy = 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Intersection size", title = NULL) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Arial", size = 7),
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), "lines"),
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 7,
      vjust = -0.8
    ),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 7,
      vjust = 0.3
    ),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

fig3d$Main_bar <- ggplot2::ggplotGrob(main_bar_plot)

size_data <- data.frame(
  set_index = seq_along(fig3d$Set_names),
  raw_size = as.numeric(colSums(
    fig3d$New_data[, fig3d$Set_names, drop = FALSE]
  ))
)

if (any(size_data$raw_size > break_lower & size_data$raw_size < break_upper)) {
  stop("Compressed Fig. 3d set-size axis is invalid: a set lies inside the omitted range.")
}

size_data <- size_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(display_size = map_broken_axis(raw_size))

size_bar_break_marks <- size_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(raw_size >= break_upper) %>%
  dplyr::select(set_index) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(mark = c(1, 2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    set_start = set_index - 0.18,
    set_end = set_index + 0.18,
    size_start = ifelse(
      mark == 1,
      break_lower - 100,
      break_lower + break_spacer - 100
    ),
    size_end = size_start + 200
  )

size_axis_break_marks <- data.frame(
  set_start = c(0.5, 0.58),
  set_end = c(0.62, 0.70),
  size_start = c(
    break_lower - 100,
    break_lower + break_spacer - 100
  )
)
size_axis_break_marks$size_end <- size_axis_break_marks$size_start + 200

size_axis_max <- max(size_data$display_size) * 1.1

size_plot_broken <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  size_data,
  ggplot2::aes(x = set_index, y = display_size)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.4,
    fill = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]],
    colour = NBT_METHOD_BASE_COLOURS[["Reference"]]
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = break_lower,
    ymax = break_lower + break_spacer,
    fill = "white",
    colour = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = size_axis_break_marks,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = set_start,
      xend = set_end,
      y = size_start,
      yend = size_end
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = size_bar_break_marks,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = set_start,
      xend = set_end,
      y = size_start,
      yend = size_end
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, nrow(size_data) + 0.5),
    breaks = NULL,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(
    limits = c(size_axis_max, 0),
    breaks = size_break_tick_display,
    labels = scales::comma(size_break_tick_raw, accuracy = 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Set size") +
  ggplot2::coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Arial", size = 7),
    panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(-0.11, 0.3, 0.5, 0.5), "lines"),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Arial", size = 7),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 7,
      vjust = 1,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "gray0"),
    axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "gray0", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

fig3d$Sizes <- ggplot2::ggplotGrob(size_plot_broken)

ggplot2::theme_set(old_theme)
fig3d
```
